body: It used a fixed 5 second budget, and the race detector (2-20x slowdown) pushed the unchanged code to about 5.5s, failing the full gate. It now parses 1.25 MB and 5 MB, best of three each, and checks the ratio: linear is about 4x, quadratic about 16x, the limit is 9x. Slowdown from -race or a loaded machine hits both timings alike and cancels out. Break-verified by making Parse quadratic in a scratch copy: the ratio went to 14.7x and the test failed.
title: TestParse_ScalesLinearly compares two input sizes instead of a fixed time budget
